title: Spend records
description: Shared definitions for the Insight views that roll up recorded spend events (program, spend): no view itself, only `$defs` the views reference by $id. A rollup sums spend events over one group; the spend_event table guarantees non-negative tokens and cost.

usd.description: A non-negative US-dollar amount as a Python decimal string (exponent form allowed: `1E-9`). No whitespace: a pattern's $ would otherwise accept a trailing newline.

rollup.description: Spend summed over one group. Its key is the group's value, null for spend without that dimension (no lane, no skill).

events.description: Spend events in the group: a group is never empty.
